setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern through the test MIDI device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 with notes C3, D3, E3 and F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) and velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. Tempo is the default 90 BPM, Rate is /1 and the sequencer is stopped. Channel 1's Device is the Digitakt configuration and Elektron program changes is On. Song slots 1 and 2 are four steps long and slot 2 plays an octave higher. Program changes are sent on the default channel 10.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Elektron p.change channel and turn E3 left nine detents from the default 10 to 1. The row shows 1.
steps.title: Set the program-change channel to 1

steps.caption: Close the menu (K2, then K1). While stopped, press song slot 2 at grid (2,1). Mosaic sends program change C0 01 (the strip shows it): program value 1 on MIDI channel 1 instead of channel 10. Set this channel to the one your receiver listens on for program changes; the default 10 suits an Elektron device left at its default.
steps.title: The next selection uses channel 1
